composition: Renaissance fortress of Copertino with dry moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands in the dry moat before the honey-colored walls of Castello di Copertino in the bright 10:03 morning. A massive round bastion dominates the right foreground, the ornate carved portal stands at center, and the crenellated walls stretch left toward a smaller tower, with a bridge crossing the grassy moat at the far left. Olive groves and fields lie beyond, and the clear blue sky warms the golden limestone.
